title: P3-11: pythonSandbox.test.ts — three-tier test strategy
description: (a) Unit on SandboxBackend with a mocked backend (every PR). (b) Integration against real local Docker sandbox (PRs touching pythonSandbox.ts or sandboxTemplates/, gated on [sandbox] label). (c) E2E against prod-image digest in nightly CI. Phase 3 merge bar: (a) green, (b) green for touched paths, plus one human-reviewed E2E run. Reference: §6.4, §11.5, §12.2.5.

title: P3-8: Per-user/day CPU + artifact byte caps + Slack alerts
description: Caps: >20 sandbox calls/min/user OR >500MB artifacts/day/user => 1h hard cap + Slack alert. Per-tenant monthly caps wired to billing. Cap breaches return structured tool errors to the model; daily-cap breaches return 429 to user. Same OZ_TOOL_AUDIT channel; alerts page through existing oncall. Reference: §11.3, §11.7, §12.2.3, §12.2.7.

title: P3-6: Sandbox startup smoke test on backend boot
description: On backend boot, pythonSandbox runs a one-off  job and emits a startup health event {ok, runtime_ms, image_digest}. If it fails, the surface marks run_python as tools_unavailable (and the system prompt registers that). Reference: §10.1, §11.7, §12.1.1, §12.2.7.

title: P3-5: Bump MAX_AGENT_ITERATIONS to 16 in chatRuntimeAgentic + OpenAI variant
description: Today MAX_AGENT_ITERATIONS=12 in backend/oz/chatRuntimeAgentic.ts:L24. Sandbox-iterating turns (run_python -> read error -> fix -> re-run -> emit artifact) often need 14-16. Raise to 16 alongside the per-tool-kind separate counter from P3-4. Same change in chatRuntimeAgenticOpenAi.ts.

title: P3-4: run_python tool — registry def + surface impl + per-turn 4-call cap
description: Tool definition in ozChatToolRegistry.ts per §2.1. Surface method calls pythonSandbox.run(). Per-turn cap of 4 run_python calls (separate counter from MAX_AGENT_ITERATIONS). Cap breach returns reason:'call_cap_exceeded' so model knows to stop. Reference: §2.1, §6.2, §12.1.1.

title: P3-3: pythonSandbox.ts — input mounting, output harvesting, structured errors
description: Top-level runner. Resolves data_refs server-side from prior tool-result cache to /sandbox/inputs/. Resolves upload_ids from oz_uploads to /sandbox/inputs/upload_<n>__<safe_name>. Walks /sandbox/outputs/ post-run: PNG/JPEG <= 1MB returned inline base64; larger or non-image uploaded via artifactStorage. Returns structured errors {ok:false, reason:'timeout'|'oom'|'nonzero_exit'|'sandbox_unavailable'|'egress_denied'|'call_cap_exceeded'|'ref_expired', stdout, stderr, exit_code, runtime_ms}. Reference: §2.1, §10.1, §12.1.1.

title: P3-2: SandboxBackend interface + LocalDockerBackend (gVisor runtime, dev/prod parity)
description: Interface SandboxBackend in backend/oz/pythonSandbox.ts: run(spec) -> {stdout, stderr, exit_code, runtime_ms, output_files}. LocalDockerBackend implements spawn/teardown via Docker with --runtime=runsc (gVisor). RemoteSandboxBackend stub for prod (mTLS HTTPS). Both enforce --network=none default, --read-only rootfs, tmpfs /sandbox, --memory=512m --cpus=1.0 --pids-limit=128. Reference: §5, §11.3.

title: P3-1: oz-sandbox container image (Dockerfile, pinned packages, CI publish by digest)
description: New Dockerfile (or multi-stage in existing) producing oz-sandbox:<git_sha>. Base python:3.12-slim. Pin pandas, numpy, openpyxl, python-docx, reportlab, matplotlib, pillow. Plotly OUT for v1 (per §12.2.1). CI builds + pushes to private registry by sha. Backend pins by digest in ozConfig.sandboxImageDigest. Reference: §6.3, §11.4.

title: D2: docs/data-retention-and-artifact-policy.md updates (Spaces TTL, signed URL TTL, redaction)
description: Document the upload bucket (24h TTL), artifact bucket (30d TTL), signed-URL TTL (1h default), redaction rules, and PII denylist. Lands alongside Phase 2 (when artifacts first hit Spaces). Reference: §6.2, §11.6, §12.2.6.

title: P2-7: GET /api/oz/artifacts/<id>/signed-url — lazy fresh-TTL endpoint
description: Lazy endpoint issued on download click in ArtifactPill. Each click returns a fresh-TTL signed URL (don't burn TTL on artifacts the user never opens). Expired/lost artifacts return 410 Gone -> pill renders 'Artifact expired'. Per-tenant authz enforced before signing. Reference: §11.2, §12.2.2.

Tests assert deterministic structure (sheet count, row count, column headers) — not byte-for-byte goldens.

title: P2-3: backend/oz/sandboxTemplates/ Python module (host-mode, Phase 2 entry)

Single source of truth — Phase 2 invokes via 'python -m sandbox.templates.<name>'; Phase 3 invokes the same module inside the sandbox container. Pin all package versions. Reference: §6.1, §11.1, §12.2.1.

title: P2-2: backend/oz/artifactRegistry.ts — Postgres oz_artifacts table + repair job
description: Table oz_artifacts (id, tenant, kind, title, key, sha256, bytes, status, created_at, ttl_at). Write order: Spaces upload first, DB insert only on Spaces success. Read path: DB miss -> 404, DB hit + Spaces miss -> status='lost' + 410 Gone. Nightly repair job HEADs Spaces for last 7 days of rows; tombstones lost rows. No retroactive recovery. Reference: §6.1, §11.4, §12.2.4.

title: P2-1: backend/oz/artifactStorage.ts — DO Spaces s3-compatible client
description: putArtifact(bytes, kind, meta) -> {id, key, sha256, signedUrl?}. Idempotent: sha256 collision returns the existing id. headArtifact(id), getArtifactBytes(id) for repair job. Configurable signed-URL TTL (default 1h). All access logged via OZ_TOOL_AUDIT. Reference: §6.1, §6.3.
